items.item_text: resume
transcripts

01. PLEASE READ THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT: Answer the following questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. You are not expected to answer at the highest level of each of these items to be qualified. The application will be evaluated for minimum qualifications. Your responses to the supplemental questions below may also be used to determine your qualifications beyond the minimum qualification requirements for this classification in a training and experience (T&E) evaluation. Referring to your application/resume, listing "see resume", or incomplete responses will NOT qualify as a response to any question. Questions that are answered in this method will be considered INCOMPLETE and may result in DISQUALIFICATION. You are required to answer ALL of the supplemental questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. Your responses to these questions are subject to verification and may be assessed in subsequent examination parts. All experience, education, training, and certification must be included in your application in order to be considered. Any sign of deliberate misinformation or intentional exaggeration will result in disqualification from this examination process and possible bar from future employment opportunities with the Ventura County Community College District (VCCCD). Select "Yes" if you have read, understood, and agree to the above statements. Select "No" if you have read, understood, and DO NOT agree with the above statements and voluntarily withdraw your application for this position. Options: Yes | No

02. Have you completed a recognized plumbing apprenticeship program? Options: I have not participated in a plumbing apprenticeship program. | I have participated in, but have not completed, a plumbing apprenticeship program. | I have completed a recognized plumbing apprenticeship program of less than four years' duration. | I have completed a recognized plumbing apprenticeship program of at least four years' duration. (Attach documentation of completion to your application)

03. How many years of full-time or equivalent plumbing work experience do you possess, including experience gained while working as a plumbing apprentice? Options: No experience | Less than 1 year | At least 1 year but less than 2 years | At least 2 years but less than 3 years | At least 3 years but less than 4 years | At least 4 years but less than 5 years | 5 or more years

04. How many years of full-time or equivalent journey-level plumbing experience do you possess? For purposes of this question, journey-level plumbing experience is defined as experience performing a broad range of skilled plumbing installation, maintenance, repair, and troubleshooting duties independently, with limited technical direction. Options: No journey-level plumbing experience | Less than 1 year | At least 1 year but less than 2 years | At least 2 years but less than 3 years | At least 3 years but less than 5 years | 5 or more years

05. Describe your plumber experience. In your response, please include: a. The organization in which you have gained this experience b. The number of years of plumber experience you have acquired c. A description of your plumber duties d. Whether the experience was at the journey level If you have no such experience, please mark N/A

06. Describe your experience working with plumbing devices, systems, and fixtures. In your response, please include: a. The name of the organization in which you gained the experience b. The duration of your experience c. the name of the manufacturer and model of the equipment you repaired or adjusted d. the specific tasks you performed relative to installation, maintenance, repair, and replacement of equipment/materials If you have no such experience, please mark N/A

07. How many years of experience do you have repairing and maintaining equipment such as backflow prevention devices, boilers, furnaces, thermostats, gas valves, fans, and air compressors? Options: No experience | Less than 1 year | At least 1 year but less than 2 years | At least 2 years but less than 3 years | At least 3 years but less than 4 years | At least 4 years but less than 5 years | 5 or more years
08. Do you possess a backflow certificate? Options: No | No, but I agree to obtain the required certification by the time of appointment | Yes (Attach a copy with your application)

09. Have you received any construction trade-related education, licenses, certifications, or formal training programs relevant to the position of Plumber? Options: No | Yes (Upload proof of completion or certification with your application)

10. Please list the construction trade-related education, licenses, certifications, or formal training programs relevant to the position of Plumber. In your response, please include: a. The name of the institution that delivered the training or awarded the degree, license, or certification b. The date of completion c. The title of the degree, license, certification, or training course d. A brief summary of the content covered If you have no such education, license, certifications, or training, please mark N/A

11. Describe your experience repairing and maintaining equipment such as backflow prevention devices, boilers, furnaces, thermostats, gas valves, fans, and air compressors. In your response, please include: a. The name of the organization in which you gained the experience b. The duration of your experience c. The name of the manufacturer and model of the equipment you repaired or adjusted d. The specific tasks you performed relative to installation, maintenance, repair, and replacement of equipment/materials If you have no such experience, please mark N/A

12. PLEASE READ THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT: Plumbers are required to work in noxious or unpleasant conditions such as extremes in odors, noise, filth, contaminants, or confined space. Do you understand and accept these working conditions? Select "Yes" if you have read, understood, and agree to the above statements. Select "No" if you have read, understood, and DO NOT agree with the above statements. Options: Yes | No

13. Do you currently possess a valid California Driver's License? Options: No | No, but I possess a valid Driver's License from another state and am willing to obtain a California Driver's License if selected for the position | Yes

14. The testing process will require access to a computer with a camera, microphone, speakers, and a reliable connection to the internet. If you do not have access to one or more of these components and would like to request alternate testing accommodations, please indicate so below. Options: I do NOT have access to one or more of the required components and would like to request alternate testing accommodations | I have access to ALL of the required components and do not need alternate testing accommodations

15. Please indicate the type of job (fulltime and/or part-time) AND the type of work (regular and/or temporary) that you are willing to accept. (Check all that apply). You will only be considered for vacancies with the type of job AND work that you are willing to accept. Options: Full-Time | Part-Time | Regular/Permanent Work | Temporary Work
Licenses and Other Requirements:
Valid California driver’s license
Obtain and maintain a backflow certificate prior to obtaining permanent status
five years of plumbing experience, one year of which must have been at the journey-level

Install, maintain, repair and replace plumbing systems, equipment, appliances, controls, and fixtures, including water, gas and sewer installation. E Read, interpret and understand information represented in sketches, drawings, blueprints, and schematics. E Install, maintain, and repair a variety of plumbing-related systems such as gas piping, lawn sprinkler, welding, and automatic fire sprinkler. E Repair and maintain equipment including boilers, furnaces, thermostats, gas valves, fans, and air compressors. E Maintain and inspect safety devices and equipment; inspect and test pipes for cross connections. E Maintain records and prepare reports; estimate materials and time needed for projects. E Install backflow prevention devices; submit reports of testing certifications to appropriate agencies. E Train and provide work direction to others as assigned. E Estimate time and materials needed; make cost estimates and order materials; maintain plumbing tools and equipment. E Operate a variety of tools and equipment such as arc and gas welders, leak detectors, power tools, forklift, and maintenance vehicle. E Notify supervisor regarding water systems malfunctions or in the event of contamination or pollution of water systems. Assist in performing other skilled maintenance duties as assigned. Perform related duties as assigned. E = Essential Duties
Completion of a recognized plumbing apprenticeship program of at least four years’ duration
